The [[Keeper of Bone]] is one of the [[Forgotten]] collectors who award [[Forgotten weapon]]s in exchange for a [[Book of Secrets]], the [[Nightfall]] end-game reward item. 

==Location==
*[[Realm of Torment]]
**{{NPC location|Throne of Secrets}}

==Dialogue==
:''"Beneath the skin of the world are its secrets... the bones that hold aloft the weight of all things. You walk upon the body and the breath of the world. Can you not feel it? Here, I will show you the truth. Bring me 1 Book of Secrets, I shall give you something crafted from the very bones of truth of this world."''
